correctness.rationale: Every subsequence embedding is uniquely specified by its periodic-block indices and residue letters; weak descents force strict increases. Slack compositions yield binomial(k+L-d-1,L). Palindrome symmetric inequalities give d=m-1+e (odd) and d=m+e (even), and q*binomial(m-1,e)*(q-1)^(m-1-e) halves have e adjacent equalities. Formal series summation proves the displayed rational GF. Exhaustive 36 profiles/314 coefficients and 2992 GF identities passed from the included executable. Finite checks corroborate but the all-integer proof is combinatorial.

value.rationale: The occurrence-weighted palindromic spectrum is a natural frequency statistic, materially different from support-only distinct-string enumeration. The classification is exact for every alphabet size q>=3, period power k>=1, and all lengths, with a rational bivariate GF and a sharp unique-embedding characterization of longest palindromes. The mathematical value is the infinite structural classification and direct all-parameter formula, not a small benchmark improvement.
